facts.business: Sundaram Brake Linings Limited manufactures brake linings and related friction materials for automotive applications.

auditor.name: V. Suresh Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: NSE imposed a fine of Rs. 3.28 Lakhs for non-compliance with composition requirements under Regulations 18, 19 and 20 of SEBI LODR; delay of five days in filing Integrated Financial Results for quarter ended 30th June 2025 with BSE; disclosure under Regulation 30 for resignation of Company Secretary not made under Regulation 30 read with Clause 7C of Part A of Schedule III.

key_risks: Non-compliance with SEBI LODR regulations leading to fines
Delay in regulatory filings with stock exchanges
Resignation of key managerial personnel (CFO and Company Secretary)
